title: The legal cut-over of RWB-DM-007 has no defined dump, no package format, no evidence store and no agreed API surface in the target
source: Legacy RWB-DM-007 (AC3, Data, Endpoints, Screen and states, Permission checks, guardrails); Ownership Map on legal_action (S4 rwb_litigation), notice (P6 rwb_comms), partner_instruction (S9 rwb_partner); FSD P1 v3 A2.2.2 DP07 row, A2.11 and A2.11.3.1; TSD P1 v3 T3.3 views 22 to 24, T3.6 reconciliation_result, Appendix T-A.1; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 32 and 44; context pack P1 (REST operations provided); D-RCV-35 U5; DL25, DL43
section: s1 Story; s3 Preconditions; s4 Flow; s5 Exception paths; s7 Acceptance criteria; s8 Business rules; s9 State transitions; s11 Data; s12.1 provided; s12.8 fakes; s13 Solution plan; s15 Screens and states
description: The legacy key migrates legal_action, notice and partner_instruction in one cutover step run by the recovery service identity in the single recovery schema, with the court record read from v_ace_lawsuit and v_ace_hearing. The Ownership Map splits the three tables across S4, P6 and S9, each in its own schema with its own login and Flyway sequence under DP-01 and DP-15, so no service can move all three and the cut-over becomes a handover. No source states the cut-over dump (its name, layout, record format and the identity that may read it), the shape of a handover package, where the cut-over record of the ten clean days and the sign-off is kept, how long the legacy tables stay read-only, how a break interacts with the count, or what the cut-over feature switch defaults to; the legacy AC3 names the outcomes only. The provided operation list also disagrees across sources: the context pack carries GET /admin/data-quality/exceptions and the five /admin/trackers rows, which FSD P1 v3 and TSD P1 v3 retire under D-RCV-35 U5 and RWB-E1-006, while the reconciliation read the ten day evidence needs (API-P1-003 GET /admin/reconciliation/results) appears in TSD P1 v3 and not in the context pack. Finally partner_instruction appears in the data table of both RWB-DM-007 and RWB-DM-008 and no source rules which facts each slice carries. Severity is P2: a wave 4 story's Done is blocked, not the wave start.
evidence: Legacy RWB-DM-007 AC3: Given ten clean days on the migrated records / When the data steward signs off / Then the legacy tables stay read-only for their retention period / And the migrated records are served from the new schema; legacy Endpoints: No endpoint in this story. The migration is a cutover step run by the recovery service identity, and its breaks are listed on the reconciliation extract.; legacy Data table legal_action DF-LEG-001 to DF-LEG-014, notice DF-LEG-015 to DF-LEG-034, partner_instruction DF-PRT-008 to DF-PRT-016, and the same partner_instruction row in RWB-DM-008; FSD P1 v3 A2.2.2 DP07 Legal events and cases over v_ace_lawsuit, v_ace_hearing, v_ace_pod and legal_action, notice, hearing, DAILY, 08:00; FSD P1 v3 A2.11.2 writes reconciliation_result per check and product group for REC-01, REC-02 and REC-05; TSD P1 v3 Appendix T-A.1 lists API-P1-003 GET /admin/reconciliation/results and retires API-P1-004 to API-P1-008 (trackers) with 'Trackers leave system scope (D-RCV-35 U5)'; the context pack P1 lists GET /admin/data-quality/exceptions and GET/POST /admin/trackers rows among the 18 provided operations; TSD P1 v3 T3.3 marks v_ace_lawsuit and v_ace_hearing Section B, shipped with RWB-ACE-001 and open under DL43; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 32 puts cutover loads through service APIs as one-off bulk work and slide 44 gives JOB-04 as an event-triggered workflow; template R5 default ruling puts feature flags in the platform library.
proposed: P1 reads the dump once, hands one package per owner per cut-over business date to S4, P6 and S9, and each owner loads its own rows on its own sequence; the ten clean days are counted from the reconciliation_result rows JOB-04 writes, a break resets the count, the sign-off and the window sit in the cut-over record of the release pipeline, the flag rwb.source-data.dm007-cutover defaults off, and the pipeline calls API-P1-002, API-P1-003 and API-P1-010; the tracker and data-quality-exception rows of the context pack are read as out of system scope under D-RCV-35 U5 and API-P1-003 is added to the Ownership Map.
